scope: Selected public world/game browser source, complete changed artwork history, required world-renderer assets, reviewed presentation adapters, focused tests and render helpers; not the full hosted backend or a complete offline app.
copyMethod: Every exported source file is copied byte-for-byte from a regular Git blob at the recorded source commit, preserving its source-relative path and executable mode.
scopeNotes: All 123 changed asset/provenance files are included, including PNG masters and intermediate historical images.
The three desktop 8k Earth textures are included because the exported earth-globe.js constructs those requests dynamically.
All six dynamically named portrait contour data textures are included.
Public catalog creator wallets and the original SolHandle project UUID are intentionally public identity pins and are preserved unchanged.
The private creator route is excluded; project-share.test.cjs explicitly supplies its own route stub.
The copied community-showcases.md contains historical v192/v193 notes; the current public release record is authoritative for later behavior.
Unrelated home, film and desert media collections are not bundled in full; additional archived browser source and templates do not imply a complete offline app.
No local web-font files are required by the selected pages; Python card reproduction uses system DejaVu or Nimbus Sans fonts.
Native AGENTS.md is classified as a source-only policy update; the public repository has its own release policy.

sourceOnlyChanges.summary: Native release-continuity policy requires each completed Site revision to receive a reviewed public GitHub update; the public policy is maintained separately.
Hosted project-wallet association API entry point; private request handling and runtime bindings are outside the public snapshot.
Hosted project directory incorporates curated showcases and original-record presentation metadata; database-backed listing implementation remains private.
Hosted growth-invoice QR generation uses explicit medium error correction; payment-service implementation remains private.
Hosted signature and official-website proof lifecycle for designated project wallets, including expiry and removal; account-bound verification implementation remains private.
Hosted creator-world routing integrates the reviewed SolHandle presentation and related project context; private data access and account handling are omitted.
Private storage models for project-wallet proof claims and active associations; no schema implementation or runtime records are exported.
Private database migration supporting project-wallet association records; migration implementation is omitted.
Private migration schema snapshot for the project-wallet storage change; omitted with the database implementation.
Private migration journal records the project-wallet storage migration; omitted with database internals.
Hosted discovery and directory regressions depend on private service/database fixtures; summarized rather than copied.
Hosted project-directory and presentation regressions depend on the private query implementation; summarized rather than copied.
Hosted payment and growth-service regression coverage remains with the excluded private service.
Private project-wallet proof, permission, expiry and isolation regression suite remains with the excluded service and storage fixtures.
Whole-application route and page-integrity suite depends on additional hosted application routes beyond this selected snapshot.
Full creator-world integration suite includes private creator-route dependencies; public presentation and share behavior are covered by the included focused suite.
Whole-application editorial route integration suite remains with omitted hosted route dependencies; the public editorial source and data are exported.
